supplements.title: Protective Role of Apigenin-PEGylated Chitosan Nanoparticles Against Pesticide Deltamethrin-Induced Liver Injury via Antioxidant Activation, NF-κB Inhibition, and Bcl-2/Bax/Caspase-3 Signaling Modulation.

supplements.title: Exploring the potential targets and mechanisms of artemisinin in the treatment of diabetic kidney disease using network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin may treat diabetic kidney disease by restoring the FLT1 protein, which protects kidney cells from high-glucose damage.

supplements.title: A bioactive pigment from violet-hued bacteria: a dual approach against prostate cancer and bacterial infections.
supplements.summary: A purple pigment from soil bacteria kills prostate cancer cells and fights bacterial infections effectively.

supplements.title: Individual Short-Chain Fatty Acids Differentially Reprogram Transcriptional States in Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Different short-chain fatty acids from gut bacteria alter gene expression patterns differently in colorectal cancer cells.

supplements.title: Biomimetic Nanoparticles Based on Tumor Cell Membrane Co-loaded with Vitamin E and Doxorubicin for Targeted Synergistic Treatment of Bladder Cancer.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticles coated with cancer cell membranes and loaded with vitamin E and chemotherapy drug effectively treat bladder cancer with reduced toxicity.

supplements.title: Integrated Network Pharmacology and Machine Learning to Reveal the Mechanisms of Schisandrin A Against Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
supplements.summary: Schisandrin A inhibits triple-negative breast cancer cell growth by targeting GSK3B and IDO1 proteins, blocking cell cycle progression and triggering cell death.

supplements.title: Histopathological and Epigenetic Insights Into Radioprotective Effects of Homeopathic Cadmium Sulfuratum in Swiss Albino Mice.
supplements.summary: Homeopathic Cadmium Sulfuratum reduced radiation damage to intestines in mice by altering miRNA expression patterns.

supplements.title: Effects of Exercise on Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise may help reduce memory and attention problems that cancer survivors experience after treatment.

supplements.title: Integrative Database-Driven In Silico and In Vitro Study of Anemarrhena asphodeloides Bunge Highlighting Hippeastrine as a Regulator of the HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR Axis in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Hippeastrine, a compound from a plant extract, kills oral cancer cells by blocking a key growth pathway called HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR.

supplements.title: Advances in extraction, purification, and pharmacological mechanisms of calycosin: a comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Calycosin from Astragalus shows promise against cancer and inflammation through multiple cellular pathways with low toxicity.

supplements.title: Resveratrol's hepatic symphony: conducting a multi-stage intervention in liver cancer's progression.
